title: Weekly Chief Inspector Report
contractor: West Tech Energy — Jose Salaises, Director of Operations

sections.heading: Executive Summary
paragraphs: Mobilization week. West Tech Energy mobilized on Friday 11/20 with 8 personnel, set up welding and fabrication areas, and started piping fabrication (118.24 weld inches) and civil layout. On Saturday 11/21, 8 personnel continued: two welders completed 9 welds on 8-inch Class 150 piping (72 weld inches) and layout of all concrete pillar locations in the combustion area was completed, ready for hydrovac excavation to 8 ft on 11/23. A field coordination meeting on 11/20 set the official 07:00 CT start time and the daily reporting, documentation and H₂S requirements. West Tech issued its scatter sheet (11/20–11/25) and crew roster (12 personnel).

Email this week closed several open items: the geotechnical report was received (11/9), the NM811 one-call ticket was issued (26NV200355), the coating spec was received (ENGSTD0006, piping color SW #6114), and the guy wires were confirmed as concrete block foundations. Open: the flare anchor bolt detail, the layout benchmark/datum review, and the completion date month ("the 18th"). MPLX announced a construction holiday shutdown December 20 – January 3. Main risks: incomplete contractor reporting, material theft on site, and H₂S exposure near the tank battery.

rows: Layout started 11/20; all concrete pillar locations in the combustion area laid out 11/21. One-call ticket 26NV200355.

Thefts reported on site; tools and materials to be secured and inventoried daily.
Open: safety coverage, fit testing for work under air, and air trailer inspection.
The 11/20 Walkdown Pro Daily Safety Scope (Safety 1) has no entries: no manpower, JSAs, permits or checklist items (0 / 24) were logged. Follow up with the safety representative.

bullets: Material receiving and review against MTRs scheduled 11/20 per scatter sheet; MTR results not reported.
Contractor QC focus: traceability, fit-up and welding per approved WPS, foundation layout checked against latest IFC before excavation.
Weld reporting gives welder names, weld counts and weld inches. Line / iso, RT shots and reader sheets still required.
No hydrotest packages submitted (required 24 hours before each test). No NCRs recorded.
